run_segment_audio_cli: run the CLI to segment audio files by speaker using pyannote VAD with configurable duration limits
split_audio_by_speaker: split an audio file into clips grouped by speaker segments from pyannote diarization output
split_audio_with_vad: split a WAV audio file into smaller segments using voice activity detection with duration constraints
create_file_segmenter: create a FileSegmenter instance to batch-segment audio files across languages with pyannote and VAD
save_and_load_timestamps: save and load start and end timestamps for audio segments as tab-separated float values
